title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt metrics into CI gating and add prompt-quality job
author: Priya Nambiar
release_notes: Add per-prompt metric integration for eval-harness CI jobs
New job: eval/prompt-quality that computes per-prompt deltas and fails the job when regressions exceed configured thresholds
Expose config flags for gating thresholds and metric selectors
description: Context: teams rely on eval-harness to detect prompt-set regressions but we only had suite-level metrics in CI. This made it hard to detect regressions that affect a small but important subset of prompts. This PR integrates per-prompt metrics into CI gating and adds a dedicated CI job (eval/prompt-quality) that runs lightweight per-prompt checks in blocking CI. Changes include: 1) metric collection: eval-harness now emits per-prompt metrics (accuracy, exact_match, rouge) with stable metric keys; 2) gating logic: a new gating layer evaluates per-prompt deltas against configurable thresholds and marks the CI job failed if any prompt exceeds regression limits; 3) CI integration: new GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yaml that runs on PRs, uploads per-prompt artifacts, and reports summary annotations; 4) CLI/config: added --per-prompt and --gating-threshold flags plus eval_harness/config.yml keys for project-level defaults; 5) docs and examples: docs/eval-guide.md updated with migration steps and examples; 6) tests: unit tests that validate metric name mapping and an integration test simulating a small prompt regression. Motivation: make regressions visible and actionable so we can catch regressions that would otherwise be lost in suite-level averages. Rollout plan: feature gate enabled for internal projects initially (config default disabled for public repos); we will run the new workflow in a few high-traffic repos for 2 weeks, tune thresholds, then enable by default. Risks and mitigations: early runs showed some flakiness in tokenization-based metrics; added retry logic and increased stability in metric aggregation. No breaking API changes to the public eval-harness API. How to review: focus on gating logic in eval_harness/gating.py, the GH Actions workflow, and the new tests under tests/eval/prompt_quality_test.py. Related: ENG-1423 (per-prompt metrics), PM-88 (rolling out prompt-quality gating).
commits: Initial integration: emit per-prompt metrics from eval-harness runner
Add gating layer and threshold config; unit tests for gating logic
Add GitHub Actions workflow eval-prompt-quality.yaml and artifact uploader
Fix: adjust metric name collision handling and retries after flaky runs
changed_files: eval_harness/runner.py - emit per-prompt metrics alongside aggregate metrics
eval_harness/gating.py - new gating layer that compares baseline vs candidate per-prompt metrics
eval_harness/config.yml - add per_prompt and gating_threshold defaults
.github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yaml - new CI job to run per-prompt checks and upload artifacts
scripts/ci/upload_eval_artifact.py - uploader for per-prompt JSON summaries

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice addition, can you add a short note about how baseline snapshots are selected? Also the default gating_threshold looks tight for smaller prompt sets.

Priya Nambiar: Baselines default to the last green merge on main; added text to docs and fallback to latest tagged baseline if present. Tight thresholds are configurable; I relaxed the default to 3% absolute for accuracy and added examples in docs.
Lina Zhou: CI job seems flaky on the tokenization-based metric, can we add retries or stabilize tokenization?
Priya Nambiar: Added retry (3 attempts) to the artifact upload step and moved metric normalization earlier in the pipeline to reduce tokenization variance. Reran CI and observed stability.
Omar Rahman: Approving after small nits fixed (doc wording and one test flake).
ci_checks: eval/prompt-quality (GH Actions) - failed on first run due to a flaky tokenization metric; rerun - pass
notes: Initial CI run surfaced a flaky metric that caused a failed run; added retries and normalization which resolved flakiness
Feature gated by default for internal orgs; enable via eval_harness/config.yml per-repo
how_to_use: To enable in repo: add .github/workflows/eval-prompt-quality.yaml and set eval_harness/config.yml -> gating: enabled: true
risk_mitigation: Retry logic for uploader and CI job
Configurable thresholds to avoid noisy failures
Docs with migration steps and rollback instructions
